correctness.rationale: Exact matrix-unit compositions yield disjoint source/sink supports and show every maximal root clique is a uniquely labeled cut. The root-incidence columns generate precisely the integer degree-at-most-two Boolean polynomial lattice; an explicit unit minor proves rank and all-one Smith factors. Boolean Möbius finite differences are a unimodular basis and give the full integer kernel; Walsh orthogonality gives its rational character decomposition, while positive semidefiniteness gives the Gram kernel. Gaussian inversion on the interior binary source/sink word proves the maximal-clique size polynomial. Boundary n=2,3,4 is covered. Standalone literal-matrix enumeration n=2..6 and independent modular rank and exact null-vector tests n=2..9 corroborate but do not constitute the infinite proof.

value.rationale: This is a natural reconstruction invariant of the maximal distinguished root-commuting supports: it specifies *all* signed distributions indistinguishable by their individual root occupancies, with an exact integral generator set, a sharp first failure at n=5, and no integral cokernel torsion in any dimension. The full quadratic-versus-higher Walsh filtration and Gaussian maximal-size polynomial give global structural information, not a random small parameter count or merely a rephrasing of maximal dimension. The objects are motivated by root-vector abelian supports and their incidence, so the integer cutoff provides reusable exact information about abelian-support measurements.
